critical_issues.issue: All 8 services images are BROKEN — no images render on /services page
critical_issues.root_cause: CMS services-page fields (service1-5.image1/image2) are all empty. No static fallback exists in page/component.
critical_issues.fix: Either populate CMS services-page media fields in Strapi admin, OR add local fallback imports in services.astro similar to how homepage handles it.

critical_issues.issue: Blueprint images on product detail pages are BROKEN
critical_issues.root_cause: CMS product fields (blueprintFirst, blueprintSecond) are empty on all 4 products. ProductDetail uses conditional render (url && ) so images do not appear.
critical_issues.fix: Populate blueprintFirst/blueprintSecond in Strapi product entries, OR add local fallback imports in ProductDetail.

critical_issues.issue: 5 homepage images use static fallback instead of CMS
critical_issues.root_cause: CMS homepage media fields are empty. Images render correctly via local fallback but are not CMS-editable.
critical_issues.fix: Populate homepage CMS media fields so content editors can change these images.

critical_issues.issue: screwfast_logo.svg is uploaded and CMS-bound but not rendered (brand mismatch)
critical_issues.root_cause: ScrewFast brand has logo set in CMS, but active site uses Brand Alpha (no logo). The fallback BrandLogo component uses its own inline SVG.
critical_issues.fix: Ensure active brand has logo set, or update BrandLogo fallback to use screwfast_logo.svg.

critical_issues.issue: screwfast_logo_dark.svg is missing from Strapi and no longer used
critical_issues.root_cause: Replaced by acme_logo_dark.svg (new file) and inline BrandLogo SVG. Not needed.
critical_issues.fix: No action needed — this is expected rebranding cleanup.

cms_integration_assessment.summary: 41.5% of baseline media is properly CMS-mapped. 24.4% is actively broken with no rendered images. 31.7% uses static fallback — functional but not CMS-editable. Key gap: services page has zero CMS image integration despite all images being uploaded.
